description.p: Paraphrase is a private AI writing assistant: a grammar checker, spell checker, paraphrasing tool and smart reply writer that runs offline, on your own computer. The AI model (Google Gemma, a local LLM) works without the internet, so what you write never leaves your computer: no account, no cloud and no usage data.

ul.li: Grammar checker and spell check: fix spelling, grammar and punctuation, with every change shown and one Undo per change
Paraphrase and rewrite: change the tone to professional, polite, friendly, casual, confident, concise or more detailed, keeping every name, date and number
Smart reply: three quick replies to a message, or a full email reply or chat reply from a few words of yours
Summarize a long email or document, or turn notes into bullet points, a table or an email
Translate, tested in English, Hindi and Hinglish, and on a best-effort basis in many more languages
Write an email, a message, a social media post or a note from a short description
Custom actions: your own instructions, saved as actions of their own
Over any app: select text, press the global shortcut, and put the result back where the text was; or use the window, paste, pick an action and copy

description.p: The AI model is downloaded once from its maker, at a fixed version, and checked before use. Downloading a model is the only time Paraphrase goes online.

description.p: The first version: a private AI writing assistant that runs on your own computer.

ul.li: Proofread, change the tone, reply, summarize, format, translate and write, in the window or over any app with a shortcut
Replies answer what the message says to you: thanks, wishes, news and questions
Models chosen for your computer: Fast (Gemma 4 E2B) with 8 GB of memory, Quality (Gemma 4 E4B) with 16 GB; switch them in Settings
Custom actions of your own, and a history that is off unless you turn it on, then encrypted
